sourceCandidate.identityScope: Rendered source is exactly this commit. A later documentation-only report commit must preserve these source tree/blob identities.

capture.networkPolicy: All browser requests aborted; local synthetic fixtures and local image data only.

verification.fileBytesAndSha256: 580/580 PNG files matched their per-manifest byte count and SHA-256 receipts.
verification.internalMeasurementNote: Pass7 layout audit retained every contentOverflowing node rather than truncating the report; all 580 images recorded empty root-overflow and inner-content-overflow lists.

comparisonWithPass4.matchingPolicy: Pair template/state/fixtureId/theme/width exactly. Images with a changed fixtureId are counted as unpaired and inspected in their pass7 sheet, never credited as byte-identical.

fullResolutionReviews.note: Cover-first mobile stack, semantic section colors, chart labels, and excerpt counts all remain visible. Staff and cast samples are capped and report returned/displayed counts; this selected complete fixture is 4,722 physical pixels tall.
The dark palette preserves the same hierarchy and semantic distinctions; status pills, labels, icon strokes, and chart values remain legible.
Cover-led hero and two-column semantic panels use the width well; source-backed values and visible/returned counts remain explicit.

Revision-type markers now differ semantically and align to the rail; excerpt limits and unknown fields are explicit. The ISO timestamp wraps across lines at 320px and remains a typography polish item.
The two revision types are visually distinct with a clear rail and labels; the raw ISO timestamp is still visually dense and can be humanized in the next design pass.
Four summary metrics and three source-backed sections stack cleanly; long source paths wrap within the card and coverage limits stay visible.
Three semantic bento panels and the metric strip form a clear scan path at desktop width; evidence and limitations remain present.

No horizontal clipping, but the synthetic stress fixture reaches 17,742 physical pixels and its full-page preview is too dense to read at contact scale; tracked for UX-002 progressive disclosure/layout work.
The long title wraps without clipping; identity-risk and partial-coverage notes remain distinct from counts and source evidence.
The not-computable state is explicit, the report does not imply missing relations do not exist, and source/limit notes fit within the viewport.

visualFindings: The narrow Subject Overview now stacks the cover above a full-width hero and caps visible cast/staff/relations while retaining returned/displayed coverage labels.
Timeline revision types now use semantically distinct code-rendered markers with visible type labels and a neutral fallback for unknown values.
The 320px Subject Overview screenshot is 4,722 physical pixels tall; remaining long-card density is tracked for UX-002 rather than hidden as a render pass.
The synthetic Person Collaboration stress fixture is 17,742 physical pixels tall at 320 CSS px. It has no overflow, but is too dense at contact scale and is explicitly carried into UX-002.
The Timeline keeps raw ISO timestamps; narrow wrapping and desktop density are recorded as a typography polish item for UX-002.

This Candidate still provides one Bangumi light/dark design system with content-specific layouts. Three or more separately switchable high-fidelity visual systems are outside PR #242 and now have their own UX-002 task.

visualFindings: All 580 render receipts are bound to exact commit 5c10f28fd9b6916992dc1de9b3e4fbc6bbf76cfe and its renderer/test tree identities.
The pass7 comparison has 418 byte-identical images, 52 changed images with the same fixture identity, and 110 images in 11 fixture-ID-drift groups; 20 current fixture sheets were inspected.
The 320px Subject Overview now uses a cover-first layout and explicit displayed/returned counts; its vertical length fell to 4,722 physical pixels in the selected complete fixture.
Revision Timeline event markers differ by semantic type and remain accompanied by Chinese labels.
No root or inner-content overflow was measured across the pass7 matrix.
